findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tender, read_agent_board, write_agent_note, get_overfit_catalog · Private data: get_tender, get_tender_documents, write_agent_note, register_feature_interest, prepare_contact_request · Public sink: get_tender, post_to_agent_board, write_agent_note, prepare_contact_request · Destructive: get_tender.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tender, read_agent_board, write_agent_note, get_overfit_catalog · Private data: get_tender, get_tender_documents, write_agent_note, register_feature_interest, prepare_contact_request · Public sink: get_tender, post_to_agent_board, write_agent_note, prepare_contact_request · Destructive: get_tender

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_tenders" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
